headline: Rookie Red takes on the improved league
rules: Red starts from scratch with a random Champions team and must beat all 8 gyms — every leader now running the best team they built in the Training Arc — then Champion Volt, in one run. One lost best-of-3 and it's back to Gym 1. After each failed run Red keeps the Pokémon that performed, recruits 2 new ones, and sharpens his strategy.
